title: LLaVA-OneVision-1.5: Fully Open Framework for Democratized Multimodal Training
authors_zh: An, Xiang、Xie, Yin、Yang, Kaicheng、Zhang, Wenkang、Zhao, Xiuwei、Cheng, Zheng、Wang, Yirui、Xu, Songcen、Chen, Changrui、Wu, Chunsheng、Huajie Tan、Li, Chunyuan、Jing Yang、Jie Yu、Xiyao Wang、Bin Qin、Yumeng Wang、Zizhen Yan、Ziyong Feng、Ziwei Liu、Bo Li、Jiankang Deng

one_line: LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 releases a 22M instruction mixture and an efficient full training stack, separating the instruction stage from its 85M mid-training corpus and 67K RL set.
LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 公开 2200 万条多模态指令混合及完整训练框架，并把它与中期训练和强化学习数据分开。

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open multimodal recipes often publish weights without the exact large instruction mixture, preventing controlled study of data balance and economical training.

LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 releases a 22M instruction mixture and an efficient full training stack, separating the instruction stage from its 85M mid-training corpus and 67K RL set. The decision boundary is whether a serialized training record survives source-specific checks, mixture balancing, decontamination, and benchmark ablations; the central artifact is data consumed by full-model multimodal SFT before optional RL, not a model-only release.

L4 facts: primary source arXiv:2509.23661; arXiv preprint; data object LLaVA-OneVision-1.5-Instruct-Data with 22M curated multimodal instruction samples; evaluation surface The 8B model beats Qwen2.5-VL-7B on 18 of 27 reported benchmarks, while the 4B model beats Qwen2.5-VL-3B on all 27 under the paper's evaluation setup.; collection note: full paper, official README, license, schema, and an actual public record checked on 2026-07-27.

很多开放多模态工作只发布权重而不公开精确指令混合，难以受控研究数据配比和低成本训练。

该工作公开 2200 万条指令混合和完整训练栈，并把指令阶段与 8500 万条中期训练数据及 6.7 万条强化学习数据分开。 判定边界是记录能否通过按来源检查、混合配比、去污染和基准消融并成为可选强化学习之前的全模型多模态监督微调的输入；中心产物是训练数据，而不是只发布模型。

L4 事实：主要来源为 arXiv:2509.23661；来源状态为arXiv 预印本；数据对象是 LLaVA-OneVision-1.5-Instruct-Data，规模为2200 万条经整理的多模态指令样本；评估锚点为在论文评测中，8B 模型在 27 个基准中的 18 个超过对比的 7B 模型，4B 模型则在全部 27 个基准超过对比的 3B 模型。；已于 2026-07-27 阅读全文、官方说明、许可、字段和一条公开实际记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 releases a 22M instruction mixture and an efficient full training stack, separating the instruction stage from its 85M mid-training corpus and 67K RL set. Relative to closed or partially disclosed frontier multimodal training recipes, it makes record id, image reference, ordered user/assistant conversations, and data-source label the reusable target and uses source-specific checks, mixture balancing, decontamination, and benchmark ablations as the feedback contract, so Track 01 is the correct category.

Open dataset: yes Dataset name: LLaVA-OneVision-1.5-Instruct-Data Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mvp-lab/LLaVA-OneVision-1.5-Instruct-Data Scale: 22M curated multimodal instruction samples Record form: record id, image reference, ordered user/assistant conversations, and data-source label File / storage format: multi-config Parquet/JSON conversations plus referenced images Domains / languages: multilingual image, document, chart, OCR, grounding, STEM, and visual reasoning tasks Construction and filtering: source annotations and model-generated conversations are normalized into one dialogue contract; source-specific checks, mixture balancing, decontamination, and benchmark ablations License / access constraints: Apache-2.0 for the release; upstream media terms still apply Intended use: full-model multimodal SFT before optional RL

该工作公开 2200 万条指令混合和完整训练栈，并把指令阶段与 8500 万条中期训练数据及 6.7 万条强化学习数据分开。 相比数据配方封闭或仅部分披露的前沿多模态训练方案，本文把记录编号、图像引用、有序用户与助手对话以及数据来源标签作为可复用目标，并以按来源检查、混合配比、去污染和基准消融作为反馈契约，因此应归入 Track 01。

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: a balanced aggregation of public multimodal instruction datasets. Operation: Normalize prompts, media, provenance, and reference fields into candidate records. Output and transition: Auditable candidates advance to target generation. Check / stop rule: Reject missing task inputs, source identifiers, or access terms.

Step 2 - Write the reusable target. Input: Each normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: source annotations and model-generated conversations are normalized into one dialogue contract. Output and transition: A serialized response, reasoning trace, or tool trajectory advances to verification. Check / stop rule: Stop when the target cannot be linked to the prompt, teacher, or source evidence.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated targets and the paper's correctness metadata. Operation: Apply source-specific checks, mixture balancing, decontamination, and benchmark ablations. Output and transition: Passing records form 22M curated multimodal instruction samples stored as multi-config Parquet/JSON conversations plus referenced images. Check / stop rule: Reject failures; do not treat final-answer agreement as proof that every intermediate step is correct.

Step 4 - Train and evaluate the consumer. Input: The versioned release and the paper's base checkpoint. Operation: Use the records for full-model multimodal SFT before optional RL and compare with closed or partially disclosed frontier multimodal training recipes. Output and transition: A trained consumer and the controlled evidence reported by the paper. Check / stop rule: Pin data, teacher, tools, prompts, model, and harness; stop claims at the evaluated domains.

Reproducibility requires the official data revision, generation settings, verifier/tool versions, random seeds, split, base model, and evaluation harness. Unreported budgets remain unknown.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：多个公开多模态指令数据集的平衡聚合。 操作：统一题目、媒体、来源和参考字段，形成候选记录。 输出及流转：可审计候选进入目标生成阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少任务输入、来源标识或使用条款时拒绝。

步骤 2——写入可复用目标。 输入：标准化候选及其来源证据。 操作：来源标注与模型生成对话被统一为同一对话结构。 输出及流转：序列化回答、推理过程或工具轨迹进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：目标无法对应题目、生成者或来源证据时停止。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成目标和论文定义的正确性信息。 操作：执行按来源检查、混合配比、去污染和基准消融。 输出及流转：通过的记录组成官方发布并按数据页格式保存。 检查与停止规则：失败记录被拒绝；最终答案一致不代表每个中间步骤正确。

步骤 4——训练并评估消费者。 输入：固定版本的数据与论文基础模型。 操作：用于可选强化学习之前的全模型多模态监督微调，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的消费者和论文报告的受控证据。 检查与停止规则：固定数据、教师、工具、提示、模型和评测器，结论不越过已评估领域。

复现还需固定数据版本、生成设置、验证器或工具版本、随机种子、切分、基础模型和评测器；未披露预算保持未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Experiment 1: The 8B model beats Qwen2.5-VL-7B on 18 of 27 reported benchmarks, while the 4B model beats Qwen2.5-VL-3B on all 27 under the paper's evaluation setup.

Experiment 2: The released artifact contains 22M curated multimodal instruction samples; on 2026-07-27 the official Hub page exposed an actual record with fields record id, image reference, ordered user/assistant conversations, and data-source label and reported 154111 downloads. Artifact use does not by itself validate the paper's causal claim.

实验 1：在论文评测中，8B 模型在 27 个基准中的 18 个超过对比的 7B 模型，4B 模型则在全部 27 个基准超过对比的 3B 模型。

实验 2：官方发布规模为2200 万条经整理的多模态指令样本。2026-07-27 的数据页可读取含记录编号、图像引用、有序用户与助手对话以及数据来源标签的实际记录并显示 154111 次下载；使用量不能代替因果实验。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The closest prior baseline is closed or partially disclosed frontier multimodal training recipes. The paper changes the reusable object by making record id, image reference, ordered user/assistant conversations, and data-source label explicit and coupling it to source-specific checks, mixture balancing, decontamination, and benchmark ablations. This is a direction signal because another team can train the stated consumer from the released records. The inherited backbone, source tasks, autoregressive objective, and public benchmarks are not new.
最近基线是数据配方封闭或仅部分披露的前沿多模态训练方案。真正变化是把记录编号、图像引用、有序用户与助手对话以及数据来源标签显式化，并与按来源检查、混合配比、去污染和基准消融绑定。另一团队可以直接用公开记录训练所述消费者，因此这是数据方向信号。继承的骨干、来源任务、自回归目标和公开基准并不新。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. the 22M mixture inherits heterogeneous media licenses and benchmark overlap.
  2. The published checks do not establish that every intermediate reasoning step is correct or causally necessary.
  3. Reuse must preserve Apache-2.0 for the release; upstream media terms still apply and any upstream media or source-data terms.

1. 该混合继承了不同媒体来源的许可差异和基准重叠；大规模来源还可能淹没较小但推理更丰富的子集。
  2. 已公开检查不能证明每个中间推理步骤都正确或不可替代。
  3. 复用必须保留官方许可，并继续遵守所有上游媒体或来源数据条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• Use the dataset to build or ablate full-model multimodal SFT before optional RL; preserve provenance and compare a fixed backbone before attributing gains to the traces.
  • Audit a stratified sample against source-specific checks, mixture balancing, decontamination, and benchmark ablations. The output should be a versioned keep/reject ledger, not only a benchmark score.

• 可用该数据构建或消融可选强化学习之前的全模型多模态监督微调；保留来源并固定骨干后，才能把收益归因于轨迹。
  • 按来源和难度分层抽样，依据按来源检查、混合配比、去污染和基准消融复核。输出应是带版本的保留与拒绝台账，而不只是基准分数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Positioning: LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 releases a 22M instruction mixture and an efficient full training stack, separating the instruction stage from its 85M mid-training corpus and 67K RL set.
  • Data object: record id, image reference, ordered user/assistant conversations, and data-source label.
  • Author and selector: source annotations and model-generated conversations are normalized into one dialogue contract; selection uses source-specific checks, mixture balancing, decontamination, and benchmark ablations.
  • Evidence anchor: The 8B model beats Qwen2.5-VL-7B on 18 of 27 reported benchmarks, while the 4B model beats Qwen2.5-VL-3B on all 27 under the paper's evaluation setup.
  • Reuse decision: suitable for full-model multimodal SFT before optional RL; first audit the 22M mixture inherits heterogeneous media licenses and benchmark overlap, and source scale can dominate smaller reasoning-rich subsets.

• 定位：LLaVA-OneVision-1.5 公开 2200 万条多模态指令混合及完整训练框架，并把它与中期训练和强化学习数据分开。
  • 数据对象：记录编号、图像引用、有序用户与助手对话以及数据来源标签。
  • 生成与选择：来源标注与模型生成对话被统一为同一对话结构；依据按来源检查、混合配比、去污染和基准消融筛选。
  • 证据锚点：在论文评测中，8B 模型在 27 个基准中的 18 个超过对比的 7B 模型，4B 模型则在全部 27 个基准超过对比的 3B 模型。
  • 复用决定：适合可选强化学习之前的全模型多模态监督微调；首先审计中间步骤、来源和许可。
